tool_input.code: var fs = await import('node:fs/promises'); var path = await import('node:path'); var root = nodeRepl.cwd; nodeRepl.write({root,readme:await fs.readFile(path.join(root,'README.md'),'utf8')}); var hits=[]; async function scan(d){for(var e of await fs.readdir(d,{withFileTypes:true})){if(e.name==='.git')continue;var p=path.join(d,e.name);if(e.isDirectory())await scan(p);else if(e.isFile()){var s=await fs.readFile(p,'utf8');s.split(/\r?\n/).forEach((l,i)=>{if(l.includes('greet'))hits.push({file:path.relative(root,p),line:i+1,text:l})});}}} await scan(root); nodeRepl.write(hits);
